scope: GLOBAL OLEANDER CONTROL PLANE / NO COMPRESSION NO LOSS / CURRENT CONTROL CARD

material_findings_before_change.finding: Machine enforcement was narrower than policy because preservation_review was mandatory only when problem_layer=Architecture.
material_findings_before_change.risk: Narrative/Web/Board/PDF/Film/App/Integration/Final-Edit restructuring could avoid no-loss by using another problem layer.

material_findings_before_change.finding: Established-object presence was represented only by a boolean plus free-form decisions.
material_findings_before_change.risk: A restructure could self-report no established objects or omit individual established objects without machine set-coverage verification.

material_findings_before_change.finding: Removal-reason rejection compared normalized free text against an exact list.
material_findings_before_change.risk: Mixed phrases such as 'reduce page count and simplify the website' could bypass the exact-match rejection.

material_findings_before_change.finding: Current CI/docs still described the earlier Architecture-only trigger and v0.2 fixture wording.
material_findings_before_change.risk: Human execution guidance could diverge from the intended current machine contract.

implemented_delta: Add Control Card v0.3 as Current stored-card schema while retaining v0.2 replay compatibility.
Require explicit change_scope.kind and affected surfaces on Current cards.
Require any declared RESTRUCTURE, not only Architecture problem-layer work, to provide preservation_review.
Require a source-bound established_object_baseline or explicit genuine-greenfield declaration.
Require preservation decisions to match the established baseline exactly: no missing, duplicate, or outside-baseline decisions.
Add MERGE and REMAP as explicit structural actions; SPLIT/GROUP/MERGE/REMAP require target_object_ids.
Require non-CUT restructuring to preserve object identity/retrievability; CUT requires concept DROP and identity_preserved=false.
Replace fragile free-text-only removal checking for Current v0.3 with structured substantive reason_code enforcement.
Require repo-wide Current Control Card scanner to reject v0.2 outside excluded provenance/replay zones.
Migrate the current active E3 Control Card and current example to v0.3 without rewriting historical review records.
Currentize Control Plane README, entrypoint, status and CI wording/compile coverage.
global_boundaries_preserved: C04 12-layer architecture is not encoded as a global template.
Historical replay/provenance remains readable and is not retroactively rewritten.
Control Plane remains the existing validator; no second registry or system-level Gate is introduced.
Concept state, presentation state and truth/evidence state remain separate.
Machine/CI PASS does not imply Design PASS, MAIN KEEP, Field/Rights/Engineering/Human validation, Promotion or Release.
validation_state: PENDING PR CI AND MAIN READBACK
does_not_prove: This owner receipt does not prove the implementation passes CI before the PR run completes.
Structured reason_code makes reduction rationale machine-visible; it cannot by itself prove the substantive truth of a human-entered reason.
The machine contract cannot infer undisclosed project objects that were never included in the baseline source; baseline quality remains authority/human-review dependent.
